# Riverside Library Annual Report

This report describes the **work of the library** in the past year and the *plans for the next one.* It is written for the board, the staff and the readers who want to know how their library is run.

## 1. Overview

The library has three branches and a mobile service. All branches kept their opening hours, and the new reading room opened in spring after a long period of assessment and planning.

The main results of the year:

- More readers visited the branches than in any year before.
- The mobile service reached eleven villages, two more than planned, and it now stops at every school on its route once a week.
- The catalogue moved to a new system.

## 2. Collections

The collections grew by four thousand items. Most of them are books for children and young readers; the rest are journals, maps and recordings.

## 3. Plans

1. Open the north branch on Saturdays.
2. Add a second vehicle to the mobile service.
